newsitem.title: UK: UK monetary meeting starts late Wednesday - Treasury.
newsitem.headline: UK monetary meeting starts late Wednesday - Treasury.

text.p: This month's monetary meeting between Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke and Bank of England Governor Eddie George will start on Wednesday afternoon, a UK Treasury official said on Tuesday.
"The meeting will start late on Wednesday afternoon," the official said.
The timing of the meeting means any change in interest rates, should one be sanctioned, is unlikely to be signalled in money market operations before Thursday.
